:::{.justify}
The sixteenth Dutch Development Economics Network Workshop is a joint international conference with the second conference of the European Development Economics Group ([EDEG](https://www.ede-group.org/)), hosted by Wageningen University on 22–23 April 2027. With keynote addresses, plenary sessions and contributed papers in parallel sessions, it showcases the latest research in development economics and offers a forum for exchange among academics and practitioners.

The conference brings together a small, curated group of researchers for an intensive exchange of ideas. Because of its workshop-style format, acceptance will be highly selective: 15–20 papers will be selected for the final programme. Submissions from early-career researchers are encouraged.
:::

### Call for papers {#call-for-papers}

:::{.justify}
Interested contributors can submit their papers by **22 December 2026, 23:59 CET** through the [online submission form](https://forms.gle/WK913ycRRnY5JG9J9){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}; only full research papers are considered. Authors will be notified of acceptance by the end of January 2027. Each presenter will be assigned a discussant, who reads the paper beforehand and gives structured feedback.
:::

[{{< fa paper-plane >}} Submit a paper](https://forms.gle/WK913ycRRnY5JG9J9){.event-download target="_blank" rel="noopener"}

### Key dates

::: {.programme}

- [22 December 2026, 23:59 CET]{.session-label} **Submission deadline** for full research papers
- [End of January 2027]{.session-label} **Notification of acceptance**
- [Thursday 22 April 2027]{.session-label} **Conference opens** in the morning
- [Friday 23 April 2027]{.session-label} **Conference closes** in the afternoon

:::

### Keynote speaker

**Christopher B. Barrett**\
Stephen B. & Janice G. Ashley Professor of Applied Economics and Management\
Charles H. Dyson School of Applied Economics and Management, Cornell University

### Registration

The registration fee is €150 per participant and includes access to all sessions, refreshments and dinner on the first day.

### Organizers

:::{.justify}
The local organizers are Ritika Gupta (Wageningen University) and Mark Treurniet (University of Groningen). Funding for this event from the Dutch Development Economics Network institutions is gratefully acknowledged.
:::
